title: Consolidated AIOS / Trinity / Council / Gateway Architecture

persona_plane.purpose: Core identity agents and their relational roles

council_plane.purpose: Role-specialized Dahlia variants for synthesis and governance
council_plane.notes: Bounded chorus with explicit specialization instead of one undifferentiated swarm

gateway_plane.purpose: Delivery, heartbeat, cron, and background execution control
mechanisms: bootstrap snapshot refresh on doc changes

data_flow: User input enters the Trinity Echo loop
Response router classifies yes / no / uncertain / stats / history / trinity
Persona weights update for Clifton / Eve / Dahlia
A persona-specific verse or response is emitted
Encounter and evolution records are written to SQLite
Gateway plane applies heartbeat / cron / background-run semantics where relevant
key_findings: Trinity Echo is the visible interaction loop.
Dahlia council models expand the Hope field into specialized subroles.
The gateway layer governs automation boundaries and session hygiene.
SQLite is the shared memory substrate beneath the system.
Heartbeat and cron are not ordinary chats; they are special run modes with separate rules.
